list: the official 55 trophies (1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze; 28 hidden on PlayStation until earned), as listed on Exophase and PSNProfiles

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.missable_reason: Pops automatically once the other 54 are earned; nothing to miss itself.
trophies.guide: The platinum has no task of its own: it unlocks the moment the last of the other 54 trophies lands. Plan the run around the gold 'A Long Road' (100% completion), which is the biggest single gate, and keep an eye on the missable list in this app so you do not need a second playthrough.

sources.name: Push Square report on the list

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.missable_reason: Opening mission; you cannot get past it without finishing it.
trophies.guide: This is the game's opening mission, named Gone Fishing in the official text. It unlocks simply by playing through the first story beat, so there is nothing to plan. Sources only confirm the mission name; no further steps are claimed here.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Story trophy for the end of Chapter 1. Keep following the main mission markers until the chapter closes; it pops on that final cutscene. Only the official description is available as a source, so no mission-by-mission detail is given.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Awarded when Chapter 2 of the story ends. Progress the main storyline and it arrives without extra effort. The listing gives only the chapter number, so this guide does not name specific missions.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Reached by finishing Chapter 3 of the campaign. Just keep taking story missions. Because the official list names only the chapter, nothing more specific is claimed.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Unlocks when Chapter 4 wraps up. It sits shortly before the finale in the chapter order, so finishing it means you are close to the ending; consider clearing side content before the last mission. Only the chapter is named by the source.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.missable_reason: Inferred, not confirmed: finishing the story can close off story-gated content in open-world games, so clear side content first or keep a save before the last mission.
trophies.guide: Gold trophy for finishing the last story mission. Because it ends the campaign, it is sensible to leave it until the collectibles, strands and contact missions you can do beforehand are done, and to make a manual backup save if the game allows it. This precaution is general advice, not a sourced fact about this game; the trophy text itself only says 'complete the final mission'.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.missable_reason: Named story mission; plays through normally.
trophies.guide: A trophy for one named story mission, Breakfast Run. Play the story until it appears and finish it. No route or objective details are claimed because the source lists only the mission name.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Story heist trophy, unlocked on finishing The Cartel Heist. It arrives through the main storyline; the listing does not describe the job itself, so no tactics are offered here.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Earned by completing the story mission Child's Play. Continue the campaign and it unlocks at the mission's end. The source gives only the name.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Story trophy for the mission Headliners. Nothing special is required beyond finishing it. Specific steps are not given since the official listing only names it.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Unlocked by completing VCIA Takedown, a story mission. Note it is related to the airport, which also features in the separate 'Catch Me If You Can' trophy. Only the mission name is sourced.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Story trophy tied to the mission Operation Savage Glory. Play through the campaign until you reach it. The listing gives no details of the mission, so none are claimed.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.missable_reason: Depends on the game's own completion tracker; check what it counts before the finale.
trophies.guide: The big gold. Press reports on the trophy list say 100% completion is needed for the platinum, so this is the one to plan around. Use this app's roadmap: finish the story, every contact's final mission, the strangers strands, collectibles and challenges, then check the in-game completion screen for what is left. The exact items the game counts are not in the sources I could reach.

sources.name: Push Square report on the list

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.missable_reason: Open-world stunts; can be done any time.
trophies.guide: A running total of 250 stunts, so it is a long-term trophy to chip at while driving or riding around. Keep a tally in this app's notes of how many you think you have and check the in-game stat page. The listing does not say where stunts are, so no locations are given.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.missable_reason: Activities stay available in the open world.
trophies.guide: Do every activity category one time each; the list data puts the number of types at 9. Treat it as a tour: pick up each new activity icon you meet, try it once and tick the type off. Several other trophies (races, fishing, arcade, drone races, shooting range) overlap with this, so do them together.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Medals are awarded per challenge, and the list data says there are 42 of them. Expect to retry the harder ones several times to hit the gold threshold. Since the exact medal targets are not given by the listing, check each challenge's gold requirement in the range menu.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win one drone race at each Top Fun location; the list data gives 14 locations. Repeat a race if you lose, and track which sites you have cleared. Location names are not provided by the sources I could read.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.missable_reason: Races are repeatable but must be different ones.
trophies.guide: Needs wins in twenty distinct races, not twenty wins of one race, so look for new race icons on the map and win each. Pick a car you handle well before starting.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Take on Cal in a fishing challenge and out-catch them. Fishing also matters for the opening mission, so learn the controls early. Details of the challenge are not in the source.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Finish any one arcade game to the end. Choose whichever cabinet is shortest. This also counts as an activity type for Master of None, most likely.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.missable_reason: Contact storyline; do it before the finale to be safe.
trophies.guide: One of the contact storylines: finish Andy's last mission. Meet Andy through the story and accept their missions as they come. Finishing contact lines before the story's final mission is the safe order.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.missable_reason: Contact storyline; do it before the finale to be safe.
trophies.guide: Complete Kenton's questline by clearing their final mission. Pick up Kenton's missions as they unlock on the map.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.missable_reason: Contact storyline; do it before the finale to be safe.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's last mission to earn it. Take every Billy mission as it appears until the line ends.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.missable_reason: Stranger strands: finish before the finale to be safe.
trophies.guide: Complete eight stranger mission strands, each a chain of missions with one person. Follow the map markers for stranger encounters around the state and finish each chain. Five contacts above (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone) have their own trophies, which may or may not be among these strands; the listing does not say.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.missable_reason: Contact storyline; do it before the finale to be safe.
trophies.guide: Randy's questline ends with a final mission; finish it for the trophy. Do each Randy request as it unlocks.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.missable_reason: Contact storyline; do it before the finale to be safe.
trophies.guide: Complete Tyrone's last mission. As with the other contacts, accept Tyrone's missions as they appear on the map.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: A collectible hunt: visit each meditation spot and meditate. The list data says there are 18 spots. Mark them as you find them; locations are not described in the sources I could access.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.missable_reason: Tied to Bret's request; do before the finale to be safe.
trophies.guide: Bret asks you to hunt one unique animal. Follow the hunting lead Bret gives you and complete it once. The animal and place are not named by the official text.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Collect the cards until three whole sets are done. Check the card menu to see which cards each set still lacks and plan around the nearest sets first.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: A 100-location collection: use the WAiNK It feature at a hundred separate places. The best approach is to do a few every time you pass through a new area and to count with the game's own tracker. Location specifics are not in the sources used.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Reach 50 completed challenges from the challenge menu. Most will be finished as a side effect of playing; check the list afterwards for stragglers.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.missable_reason: Can be triggered any time in free roam.
trophies.guide: Cause trouble until you hit four stars while your partner is with you, then break away from the police together and wait for the level to clear. Hiding spots and fast cars help. This is a repeatable free-roam attempt.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Hold up three shops in a row with your partner, keeping the wanted level active the whole time, so do not break away between shops. Pick three stores near each other. If you lose the stars, start the chain again.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Find or drive 100 different vehicle types so the game registers them as discovered. Check the vehicle discovery list for what is still missing and swap rides often.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Activate Combat Focus in a fight with several enemies and drop five before it runs out. Work through a group of weak enemies rather than armoured ones.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.missable_reason: Inferred, unconfirmed: an airport escape may be gated to a mission or to a one-off opportunity.
trophies.guide: The official text says only 'unscheduled departure at VCIA', which most plausibly means leaving the airport by an unusual route. The sources do not explain how, so no method is claimed. Keep a save before airport missions in case it is mission-tied.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.missable_reason: Inferred, unconfirmed: the cryptic text hints at a one-off tank encounter.
trophies.guide: The description is a hint rather than a task: it refers to Rhino tanks. How the trophy is triggered is not documented in the sources used, so treat this as to-be-researched and avoid destroying or wasting tank encounters.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store while staying unseen the whole time, using stealth rather than a loud entrance. If you are spotted, restart and try again.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Five bank vault robberies, each time getting away. Plan the escape car and route before every job.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Stop and rob an armored truck and then get away from the police. One success is enough.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Uncover the whole map. The list data indicates 52 areas to explore, so check the map for greyed regions and visit each one.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Raid one illegal operation per gang; the list data says there are 9 gangs. Keep a note of which gangs you have hit.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Have a cocktail at a spot with a view on Ocean Beach. The title suggests an early-game location, but the official text gives nothing else.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.missable_reason: Inferred, unconfirmed: depends on a showroom scenario that may be one-off.
trophies.guide: Drive out through the glass of a vehicle showroom. Which showroom is not named in the sources, so find one yourself and avoid wrecking the chance by other means.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Bowl at the Kolt & Associates alley. A single full roll should do, though the listing does not specify a score.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.missable_reason: Inferred, unconfirmed: cryptic text, likely story-bound.
trophies.guide: The text is a riddle about a partnership. The sources do not explain the trigger, so treat as unknown and note anything that happens in the story involving your partner.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.missable_reason: Inferred, unconfirmed: a counted tally of choices, so it builds up over the whole story.
trophies.guide: The list data says PlayStation tracks a count of up to 500 for this one, so it accumulates as you make choices. Make decisions rather than skipping dialogue and avoid reloading over them.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.missable_reason: Inferred, unconfirmed: suggests succeeding after failing something once.
trophies.guide: The hint implies you must do something successfully on a second attempt after failing the first. Which activity is unknown from the sources; keep notes when you fail something.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.missable_reason: Inferred, unconfirmed: likely a rare random or hidden event.
trophies.guide: A cryptic trophy about witnessing something odd. The sources give no trigger, so explore at odd hours and places and watch for strange events.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Hit someone with a melee attack from a moving vehicle, knocking them down. Use a bike or open-top car with a melee weapon.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder marked bills via your contacts until you have earned $250,000 from it in total. It is a grind, so start laundering as soon as marked bills turn up.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend a total of $100,000 in shops; purchases add up across all shop types. Late-game cash makes this effortless.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy every garage property; the list data gives 8 of them. Save money from heists and laundering for this.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register ten vehicles with the Scooter Bros app. Do it with vehicles you gather for the discovery trophy.
